category_title: Proactive Korean international students who voice ideas and hold ground in group discussions
student_description: This student is highly conscious of peer evaluation and feels a strong responsibility to act as a 'model student,' leading to withdrawal when faced with stubborn peers. They uniquely require instructor validation of their work before sharing it with groups, as well as active instructor mediation to ensure a non-judgmental environment. Over time, they benefit from clear rubrics and sustained group work to build assertiveness.

criteria.rationale: Clear rubrics and strict grading standards provide the structured expectations this student needs to work independently and seek help when necessary.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must include the use of clear, explicit rubrics or grading standards to guide the student's independent preparation.

criteria.rationale: Over time, mandatory and significant group interaction helps this student realize that expressing differing opinions is acceptable and not inherently rude.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must incorporate sustained, high-stakes group work that requires regular peer interaction over an extended period.
